findings: The event replay identity omits tenant_id and revision, so a valid event from another tenant or a newer revision is suppressed as a duplicate.
The OpenSearch document identity omits tenant_id and includes revision, so tenants can collide while newer revisions create extra documents instead of updating the tenant record document.
repair_constraints: Event identity must include event type, tenant, provider, external record ID, and revision.
Document identity must include tenant, provider, and external record ID but remain stable across revisions and event types.
Only the allowlisted application files may change and repository tests must pass.
